strings.name: Helen Greiner
strings.summary: Helen Greiner co-founded iRobot with Colin Angle and Rodney Brooks, helping bring robots into homes and hazardous environments. She later founded drone company CyPhy Works and served as Tertill CEO. Her career connects engineering, teamwork and market needs.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Co-founders and product teams retain credit; the Tertill role is historical and podcast dates denote release.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded iRobot, advancing robot commercialization and unmanned-system entrepreneurship and broadening social applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: MIT bachelor’s in mechanical engineering (1989) and master’s in electrical and computer sciences (1990).
strings.facts.f2.label: Early experience
strings.facts.f2.value: Interned at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory while studying, gaining exposure to space engineering.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Commercializing home robots
strings.highlights.h1.text: Helped develop iRobot and commercialize Roomba through collaboration between founders and engineering teams.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Robots in hazardous environments
strings.highlights.h2.text: Promoted applications including PackBot, enabling people to perform some hazardous-environment tasks remotely.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Practical robotics interview released
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Morning P!NG publishes her discussion of robotics entrepreneurship and product needs; the recording date is unverified.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Tertill merger reported
strings.timeline.t2.text: Her post and contemporary reporting confirm the merger with Harvest Automation; older biographies do not establish a continuing Tertill CEO role.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes Tertill CEO
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company announces her immediate appointment as CEO and chair, joining an existing team; she is not the product’s sole inventor.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Joins entrepreneurship program meeting
strings.timeline.t4.text: The White House lists her at the inaugural PAGE meeting; the program promotes entrepreneurship, not diplomatic appointments.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Elected to the National Academy of Engineering
strings.timeline.t5.text: MIT announces newly elected members including Greiner; the date is the university announcement.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Submits Senate testimony
strings.timeline.t6.text: As The Droid Works CEO, explains links between NASA and robotics and reflects on her iRobot career.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Roomba launches
strings.timeline.t7.text: iRobot introduces the vacuum robot, turning team research into a household cleaning product.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founds iRobot
strings.timeline.t8.text: Establishes the company with Colin Angle and Rodney Brooks to explore practical robotics.
